Day 28 · Circuits

Build a circuit.

*|IF:FNAME|*Hi *|FNAME|*,*|ELSE:|*Hi there,*|END:IF|*

A circuit is the list of venues your reps work. You build it from 31,000+ licensed venues across QLD, NSW and VIC.

01Search
Narrow by name, suburb, venue type and distance.
02Select
See each venue with photos, contacts and a map link. Venues already on your books are marked.
03Attach an offer
Add an intro deal and every account on the circuit gets it.
04Hand it to your reps
The circuit becomes jobs in your reps’ app.

Venue types to choose from include bars, hotels, pubs, bottle shops and restaurants.

Straight answer

Which venues will my reps actually visit?

The ones on your circuit. You see the list, you can change it, and your first 10 site visits are lined up before day one, with a typical 20–30% conversion.
